The herb would be difficult to prepare, and require skill; And taking it would leave the subject soothed, yes, but also largely incapable, for the duration of their soothing. They would need the assistance of many, in their weakened and recovering state, to preform even the most basic functions of life. Very burdensome. Perhaps a soothing of pain in the final hours. At most a minor extension of time, if the healer is truly skilled. But that drug is far and truly too cursed to be so easily countered.

Please accept this change, in the name of keeping the intentions of the gods regarding such substances from falling to the wayside entirely.
